messages:
rachel: Quick sync on the benchmark narrative for launch. Need a single coherent story that works for blog, webinar, and the product page. Thoughts on emphasis?

tom: We should lead with predictability: customers care more about P95 tail and predictable cost than peak throughput. Then show cost levers (batching, cache, quant).

priya: Agree. For social and email we can pull one big stat. For the whitepaper/webinar use three panels: methodology, results (latency + cost), and operational playbook.

dave: Chart ask for design: 1) dual-axis line chart cost per 1k tokens (log scale) vs p95 latency, 2) small multiples showing cached vs cold-start latency distribution, 3) KPI cards (p50, p95, cost delta).

luis: Routing decision: CTA "See enterprise SLA" -> AE + enterprise lead tag; "Try API" -> dev sandbox; "Request deep benchmark" -> gated form to AE. Also tie webinar RSVP to nurture sequence in HubSpot.

rachel: Good. For claims we must include methodology note. Draft: "Measured by replaying anonymized production traffic over our runtime with and without prefix caching and INT8 quantization. Results aggregated across 20k sessions."

priya: Can someone paste the latest numbers? We should avoid exact copy of earlier thread stats.

tom: Latest internal numbers from the replay run v1.1: p50 cold: 120ms -> 58ms (with routing + cache), p95 cold: 500ms -> 210ms, cost per 1k tokens: $6.0 -> $1.8 with batching+cache+int8. Workload: 20k sessions, avg seq 750 tokens, 90th percentile session tokens 2,500.

dave: Those are solid. Callouts: highlight >2.5x cost reduction and <50% p95 latency. But language: "up to" vs "typical". Use ranges: "typical observed cost reduction: 2-3.5x depending on cache hit rate."

luis: For the landing page we should produce two variants A/B: A emphasizes headline metric card ("3x lower unit cost"), B emphasizes predictability (p95 chart + methodology). We'll route enterprise traffic to B via UTM.

rachel: Webinar structure idea: 20m product walkthrough with live charting of a replay, 20m deep dive with SRE on caching & batching, 15m customer case study, 5m CTA/demos. Need to lock speakers.

priya: Design checklist: colors for bands (cached = #c6f6d5, quantized = #cfe8ff), include a small methodology footnote under charts. Also produce exportable PNGs for social.

tom: Messaging bullets for copy deck: 1) Predictable tail latency under load, 2) Optimize unit economics with batching + cache + quant, 3) Seamless fallbacks between model variants to keep SLAs. Keep each under 10 words for hero/CTAs.

dave: Legal/accuracy check: include statement "accuracy measured on eval set with <1% relative regression for INT8". Priya, can you run this by legal?

priya: On it. Also will draft gated whitepaper outline and share by Friday.

luis: Lead routing implementation: will add two new UTMs for the campaign and update HubSpot to tag AE queue for enterprise leads. Also add webinar RSVP -> AE follow-up for attendees who request benchmarks.

rachel: Action items: tom  (sorry) -- tom: upload full CSV + reproducible harness script to the repo by Thu. priya: draft whitepaper + gated slide deck by Fri. dave: mockups for 3 charts by Mon. luis: pipeline routing + UTMs by Wed. I'll compile a launch comms brief after we have design mocks.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Content review meeting scheduled Thu 9:30am. Added benchmark draft to the agenda. :bell:
